Pronunciation-only fixes left out (S4): رقبة Q, شعر, ضلوا, أعود/أقعد, طاقية, حمار->أحمر self-fix. 1:08:08 Amal's line on بيض is garbled.

No CHAT lines in this transcript. Skipped as S4: ركبتك/ركبة, sha'ar/شعر, حواجب, riqaba/رقبة, تاية/طاقية, أعود/أقعد, دلوا/ضلوا, خصلات/كصلات for كلسات, الشاب/الشعب. English 'guidance', 'link', 'app', 'tan', 'transcript' not on her sheet; 'short' = شورت on sheet (same word); 'blouse'/'pantalón' likely the engine rendering بلوزة/بنطلون. r3_note: Amal has no lines at all from 00:00 to 20:17 (her audio missing / connection drop at ~18:00), so D1-D3 and D12-D14 cannot be checked against her reaction. Farsi aside at 17:31-17:42 is not Arabic. Latin-transliterated Medi stretches 25:00-50:00 are ASR; letter-level readings there are soft.
